newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark crosses off lows but dampened by dlr/mark.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark crosses off lows but dampened by dlr/mark.

text.p: 0845 GMT - Mark edges up from earlier lows on most crosses after starting softer across the board in Europe, but still pressured by renewed energy in dollar/mark.
* Dollar/mark eyeing recent multi-year high after U.S. Treasury Secretary Rubin reiterates support for strong dollar.
* BME/Reuters German Purchasing Managers' Index drops to s/a 55.32 in July from June's 56.73. Index shows 11th straight month of expanding manufacturing activity, though pace slower.
* German June wholesale prices up 5.4 pct y/y vs May's -6.1.
* Mark at 3.3709/14 French francs vs Thursday's 3.3721/23, mark/lira at 975.60/80 vs 975.70/00.
* Punt recovering vs mark after slipping Thursday on punt slide vs sterling. Punt at 2.6755/05 vs Thursday's 2.6700/50.
* Guilder steady after Dutch central bank held key special advances rate unchanged Thursday. Mark/guilder at 1.126300/6375 vs 1.1263/64.
